It preserves the current `rank[14]` permission gate and keeps the full-edit rank (`rank[14] == 2`) able to bypass the owner restriction.", "reason": "The attacker can horizontally change the POSTed id to another user's article. Because `edit_item` is called without checking that the article's stored author matches the current user, an authorized low-level editor can update an article they do not own.
